About

I ship applied AI that survives real-world traffic — not just demos.

I'm an AI Software Developer at CariCanary, building full-stack and applied-AI features for an enterprise platform used by nursing homes and senior-living communities. Day to day I work across Vue 3, Laravel/PHP, Python and FastAPI on AWS / GCP — designing REST APIs, building responsive frontends, and integrating Python-based AI services.

Before anything ships, the questions I ask aren't just “does it work?” — they're does it scale, is it secure, and can we measure its impact? I hold a Master's in Computer Science (AI in Data Science) and care about clean tested code, low-latency inference, and accessibility for real users.

  • 5+Years building production software
  • 200K+Learners served on a live platform
  • 94%+Computer-vision model accuracy
  • <100msInference latency in production
